description: This is a FastAPI router module for messaging functionalities, including listing, creating threads, and sending/listing messages between users. It defines API endpoints for managing messaging threads and messages, handles database interactions via SQLAlchemy, and includes internal helper functions for data transformation.

methods.name: ThreadPublic _thread_public(t: Thread)
methods.description: Transforms a Thread model instance into its public representation (ThreadPublic).

methods.name: MessagePublic _message_public(m: Message)
methods.description: Transforms a Message model instance into its public representation (MessagePublic).

methods.name: list[ThreadPublic] list_threads(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all messaging threads associated with the current user.

methods.name: ThreadPublic create_thread( other_user_id: int = Query(..., description="The user id to chat with"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new messaging thread with another user or returns the existing one.

methods.name: list[MessagePublic] list_messages( thread_id: int, limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists messages within a specific thread, verifying user participation.

methods.name: MessagePublic send_message( thread_id: int, payload: MessageCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates and sends a new message within a specified thread, verifying user participation.
